say:1:1631941001:1.text: Because the library ghost scares them even more.
say:1:1631941001:1.source_cn: 他们因为在图书馆受到了更大的惊吓。
say:1:1631941001:1.male: Because the library ghost scares them even more.
say:1:1631941001:1.female: Because the library ghost scares them even more.

say:2:1631941002:1.text: My tricks just pale in comparison.
say:2:1631941002:1.source_cn: 我的那些把戏全都没用了。
say:2:1631941002:1.male: My tricks just pale in comparison.
say:2:1631941002:1.female: My tricks just pale in comparison.

say:3:1631941003:1.text: Hmm, how else can I spend my free time?
